same_run_input_xam_correlation_20261025.termination: External SIGINT at 90 seconds while the process remained live; no guest trap, SIGSEGV, or SIGBUS was logged.
same_run_input_xam_correlation_20261025.interpretation: This exact run confirms that A and Start reached successful retail user-0 XamInputGetState samples. The candidate raw-mask getter and button-change dispatcher did not observe those bits. The final guest stack sample was inside the retail predicate 0x823A0310; this point-in-time sample does not establish a permanent stall. The trace does not identify the active screen or prove a menu or race transition, and no pixel readback was captured.
